title: Senate Passes 90-6 Stopgap Funding Bill, Averting October Shutdown; SAVE America Act Punted to September
detail: In a late-night session ending early Saturday, August 8, 2026, the Senate voted 90-6 to pass a bipartisan continuing resolution extending federal funding from the October 1 deadline through December 11, pushing any shutdown fight past the midterm elections. The bill blocks the administration from redirecting state grant funds and bars money transfers to Border Patrol. Separately, Senate Majority Leader John Thune, Trump, and Senate conservatives reached a deal to set aside a budget resolution vote and defer action on Trump's SAVE America Act (a proof-of-citizenship voting requirement) until after the August recess, despite Trump's earlier demand that the Senate cancel its break until the bill passed. The House must still approve the funding measure when it returns from recess before it reaches Trump's desk.

media.caption: Trump had demanded the Senate cancel its August recess to pass the SAVE America Act; senators instead punted the bill to September

title: Senate Narrowly Confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General, 50-49
detail: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as US Attorney General in a mostly party-line 50-49 vote early Saturday, August 8, 2026, capping a difficult confirmation fight. Republican Senators Susan Collins and Lisa Murkowski joined all Democrats in voting no. Blanche, Trump's former personal criminal defense attorney, had been serving as acting attorney general since April 2026 after Trump forced out Pam Bondi. His confirmation fills a Cabinet post that had been in limbo for months amid Senate scrutiny of his ties to Trump's personal legal team.

media.caption: Senate narrowly confirms Todd Blanche as US Attorney General
